answer: Proof-of-Stake creates Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital, acting as a walnut shell protecting the network core. An attacker must burn the ember of their own resources to secure voting power, creating a financial canyon that makes creating thousands of fake identities prohibitively expensive. By tying identity to economic risk rather than anonymity, the protocol ensures that an adversary cannot influence consensus without incurring measurable, unrecoverable losses.
